wave.name: Foundation
wave.description: DB schema + state machine — ядро системы

feature.title: DB Schema
feature.description: SQLite schema: 7 tables (features, waves, packets, packet_runs, workers, leases, events) via SQLAlchemy

feature.title: State Machine
feature.description: 8 canonical states (DRAFT, READY, RUNNING, ACCEPTED, MERGED, REJECTED, FAILED, CANCELLED) with validated transitions

feature.title: PacketExecutionAdapter
feature.description: Bridge: DB packet → materialize markdown → call legacy run_e2e_packet(dry_run=False, execute_agent=True) → parse E2EPacketRunnerResult → return ExecutionResult. Stateless, does NOT change packet state.

feature.title: FastAPI Server
feature.description: 9 endpoints: GET /api/features/, GET /api/features/{id}, GET /api/packets/, GET /api/packets/{id}, GET /api/workers/, POST /api/workers/register, POST /api/workers/heartbeat, POST /api/packets/claim, POST /api/packets/{id}/release, POST /api/architect/plan, GET /health. Bind 127.0.0.1:8042.

feature.title: Worker Loop
feature.description: Worker: register → heartbeat(30s) → claim(READY→RUNNING) → adapter.execute() → release(RUNNING→ACCEPTED/REJECTED/FAILED). SQLite-safe lease with expiry.

feature.title: CLI Commands
feature.description: grace architect plan <file>, grace packet list/get, grace worker start, grace api start, grace health. Rich formatting, JSON output option.

feature.title: E2E Vertical Slice
feature.description: Full flow: architect plan → worker claim → adapter execute → release → ACCEPTED. Shared DB via GRACE_DB_URL env var.

feature.title: Legacy Code Smoke
feature.description: Verify legacy code (flows/, platform/, tasks/) works with prefect_compat. All imports use try/except.

risk.title: Adapter incompatible with real run_e2e_packet
risk.description: PacketExecutionAdapter must materialize markdown parseable by parse_packet_markdown. If format mismatch, adapter will fail at runtime.
risk.mitigation: Fixture-test on a real packet before Phase 1 complete. Verify parse_packet_markdown can read adapter output.

risk.title: SQLite race condition on claim
risk.description: Two workers could claim the same packet between SELECT and INSERT. SQLite has no FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
risk.mitigation: MVP-0 uses single worker. Post-MVP: unique constraint on lease(packet_id) + retry on IntegrityError.

risk.title: Prefect remains transitive dependency
risk.description: Legacy code imports from prefect. prefect_compat handles no-op mode, but prefect package still required in pyproject.toml.
risk.mitigation: Keep prefect>=3.0.0 in dependencies. Document as transitional. Remove in post-MVP if legacy code fully migrated.

risk.title: E2E test and API server use different databases
risk.description: API server starts with default DB path, test process may use different path.
risk.mitigation: GRACE_DB_URL env var passed to API server process before startup. Test and server share same SQLite file.

risk.title: Port conflict with running services
risk.description: Port 8042 must be free on the deployment host.
risk.mitigation: Verified port 8042 is free on current system. Configurable via GRACE_API_PORT env var.
